risk_reasons: Every rebuilt suite executes real migration DDL against the shared local Postgres container, which every other live-DB suite reads
Moving the CI test service from postgres:16 to postgres:17 changes the major every test lane runs on, including the e2e lane
A migration guard that passes vacuously is a silent loss of the only regression control on deny-all RLS and client-role grants
goal: Every migration guard suite named in #1301 proves its migration by EXECUTING it against a live catalogue instead of parsing its SQL text, and CI runs on the PostgreSQL major both Supabase projects run.
non_goals: Fixing issue #1173 — the worker autonomy boot line is already built on the unmerged branch fix/batch-e-screens-vs-runtime and closes when that branch lands
Fixing RT-5 of #1307 — the stale preflight clause was already date-qualified by commit 08c2b4a0e on 2026-09-17
Changing any migration SQL file; the checked-in files are applied verbatim and are not edited
Rebuilding migration guard suites outside the #1301 list, including 074, 076, 077, 078, 088, 116, 119, 121 and 122
Adding a second CI test lane; the existing lane moves to postgres:17 rather than being duplicated
Changing scripts/test-db-setup.sh provisioning behaviour beyond the container major
user_visible_behavior: A developer who drops an index, a constraint, a REVOKE or a row-security setting that one of the seven migrations establishes sees that suite fail, whatever whitespace, comment or string-literal form the migration file uses
A developer who runs the seven suites against a container left behind migrations head sees a named failure telling them to run pnpm test:db:setup, not a silent pass
The seven suites leave the shared container byte-identical to how they found it, so a suite running after them reads the same catalogue
CI's test and e2e jobs run PostgreSQL 17, so migration 122's MAINTAIN statements execute in CI for the first time
ci:live-db-suites names every one of the seven suites in MIGRATION_SHAPE_FILES, so their DDL is sanctioned and their cross-process lock enrolment is checked
invariants: Live-DB rule R1 — every suite reaching the shared Postgres is named *.integration.test.ts, so it runs in vitest's serialized integration project
Live-DB rule R2 — DDL at run time is sanctioned only through MIGRATION_SHAPE_FILES, and every entry holds the cross-process lock via acquireLiveDbLock
The shared test container is left unchanged: each executing case runs inside one transaction that always rolls back, so no later migration's effect is lost
No executing case can pass vacuously: the degrade is proven to have landed before the migration is applied
The checked-in migration file is applied verbatim, read from disk, never re-typed or normalised in the suite
A suite asserts the catalogue, never the migration's SQL text — the lesson of #1171's five red-team passes
No migration SQL file changes, so both Supabase projects stay in lockstep and no apply is owed
edge_cases: Later migrations layer on these tables — 057 drops NOT NULL on impersonation_sessions which 048 creates, and 122 sweeps client grants on every public table — so a destructive degrade followed by a verbatim re-apply would NOT restore head; the rolled-back transaction is what makes the pattern safe
None of the seven migration files carries its own BEGIN; or COMMIT;, unlike 119, so all seven can run inside an outer transaction — this was checked, not assumed

All seven migrations are re-runnable in place (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, a catalogue-guarded DO block, and ALTER COLUMN DROP NOT NULL), so #1301's idempotency caveat does not bite any of them
PostgreSQL 17 adds the MAINTAIN privilege, so a privilege enumeration authored on 16 reads differently on 17; the CI and local majors move first, before any suite is authored
053 runs an UPDATE before its DDL, so its executing case seeds a stray sales_partner row inside the transaction and asserts the conversion, then rolls back

057 degrades by reinstating NOT NULL, which fails if any existing row holds NULL in those columns; the degrade runs inside the transaction after the suite asserts the columns hold no NULL, and reports a named failure if they do
A container behind migrations head makes the head-posture cases fail first; each names pnpm test:db:setup in its message
The pure harness executes no DDL and opens no connection of its own, so it stays off MIGRATION_SHAPE_FILES and is never asked to hold a lock it does not own

rollback_plan: Revert the merge commit. No migration SQL changes, so neither Supabase project is touched and no apply or inverse is owed. Reverting restores the six text-guard suites, removes the 118 suite, and returns the CI and e2e test services to postgres:16. The only local action is recreating the test container on postgres:16 and running pnpm test:db:setup, and the container is disposable.
observability: A CI run on the PR is itself the evidence: the test and e2e jobs report the postgres major they ran, and the seven suites report pass or fail per case
ci:live-db-suites failing with unlocked-ddl or runtime-ddl is the signal that a suite executes DDL outside the sanctioned, locked path
